text_block_list.name: Ayabe & Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... ah, AHH!! Nice, so good—this is 
the absolute best!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"More! More, even more! Let's keep playing 
our melody together!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brushing aside both the golden hoofprints 
and the creeping newcomer, standing the 
tallest among this quartet!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...So noisy, honestly. Go do whatever you 
want.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right. I'll do that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Your voice, which steadfastly carries the 
aria, nonetheless— and because of 
that—overlaps with our voices, and—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It will surely reach that child listening 
closely somewhere far away from here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Ayabe-san, you know what this 
means, right? The next stage, the next 
performance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"What would truly be fitting, of course, 
is a stage where the world's greatest 
Umamusume gather—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That's why. ...I don't know anything 
about your stage or whatever."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawa... A-Ayabe-san walked away...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufu... They haven't gone anywhere, Doto.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There was no need to hear anything beyond 
that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Next. Would the Japan Cup work for you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Let's stay on the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown route as is. ...The distances are 
just right, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that I'm taking you up on the 
offer.
choice_data_list: ? ...Alright, let's aim for the Japan Cup!
? ...Yeah, let's aim for the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Countin' on ya for training.

The next target is the Japan Cup. It's 
only a month away—it'll be here in no 
time.

We need an intensive training regimen in 
this short timeframe. ...So that she can 
race with her heart pounding with 
excitement, just like today—no, even more 
than today.

"As her Trainer, I psyched myself up once 
more."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa... Ngh... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...They're so fast. Everyone is so 
strong..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh...
